pieces.Text: You can control your breath and the flow of vital energy within your body. Without preparation, you can hold your breath for
minutes (after this, you must begin making Constitution checks or risk suffocation); by spending a full-round action preparing yourself, you can increase this duration to

hours. You can survive twice as long as normal without food or water before you start to take penalties. You can put yourself into a state of suspended animation as a move action, and are then unconscious and appear completely dead; you awaken at a preset time or in response to a condition set by you when you enters this state.
